prompt:
Subject: A false belief treated as certain.

Composition: Show a fictional adult arranging an ordinary television toward them and solemnly saluting its neutral presenter as if personally appointed to a royal role, while a companion looks gently concerned. Make the imagined status unsupported by the ordinary room, without threatening conspiracies or diagnostic caricature.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. No text, speech balloons, explanatory captions, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
en: A fictional adult solemnly salutes a neutral television presenter as if personally appointed to royalty.
ja: 架空の大人が中立的なテレビ司会者に、自分が王族に任命されたかのように厳かに敬礼する。
